description: Horizontal counting line across the vertical middle of the 1920x1080 frame. The clip is a produced explainer animation (map, KPI cards, a mock 'CAM 02' panel), not footage from a fixed camera, so this line is a placeholder that exercises the pipeline; it is not a calibrated gate line.

line.note: Directed a->b (left to right); the positive side is below the line (image y grows downward), so moving downward = inbound, upward = outbound.
